spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.meaning: Beneath a garlanded arch of four wands a community rejoices, marking stable homecoming and shared celebration.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.meaning: Reversed, the juggling fails as over-commitment tips into chaos.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.meaning: The queen gazes into her ornate cup by the sea, embodying deep compassion, calm and intuition.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Four of Wands (权杖四) upright, highlighting celebration, harmony, marriage. Present (现在) draws Two of Pentacles (星币二) reversed, highlighting over-committed, disorganization, overwhelmed. Future (未来) draws Queen of Cups (圣杯王后) upright, highlighting compassionate, caring, emotionally stable. No Major Arcana appeared, so the reading turns on everyday, practical forces you can act on directly rather than on larger destiny-level themes. 1 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
